cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

def ackf(la, first, pairs, ecn=None, typ=2):
    out = bytes([typ]) + W.v(la) + W.v(0) + W.v(len(pairs)) + W.v(first)
    for g, r in pairs: out += W.v(g) + W.v(r)
    if ecn: out += b''.join(W.v(x) for x in ecn)
    return out

# ack first > la -> FE  (first = 11 > 10)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ackf(10, 11, []), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ack-first>la", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# overlong body varint canonicalized minimally
body = bytes([0x10, 0x40, 0x05])   # MAX_DATA=5 overlong 2-byte
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, body, width=1), auth=[0])])
canon = bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00]) + bytes([0x01,0x10,0x05])
check("overlong-minimize", tr, {'packets.0.sha256': hashlib.sha256(canon).hexdigest()})

# lengthless stream canonical
body = stream(0, 0, b'', fin=False, length=False) + b'hello'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, body, width=1), auth=[0])])
canon = bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00]) + bytes([0x08,0x00]) + b'hello'
g = check("lengthless-stream", tr, {'packets.0.sha256': hashlib.sha256(canon).hexdigest(), 'streams.0.prefix':5})

# coalescing only for long headers: I,H packets in one datagram; A terminal
e1 = envelope('I', 0, b'\x01', width=1)
e2 = envelope('H', 0, b'\x99', width=1)   # FE closes
e3 = envelope('H', 1, b'\x01', width=1)   # CLOSED
tr = trace([dict(keys=['I','H']), datagram(e1+e2+e3, auth=[0,0,0])])
g = check("coalesce-long", tr, {'datagrams.0.packets':3, 'datagrams.0.accepted':1,
                                'packets.2.status':'CLOSED', 'closed.packet':1, 'closed.event':0})
print("   bytes:", g['datagrams'][0]['bytes'], "expect", 13)

# A consumes rest of datagram: payload includes following bytes
wire = envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1) + b'\x01'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(wire, auth=[0])])
g = check("a-terminal", tr, {'datagrams.0.packets':1, 'packets.0.status':'OK'})
print("   accepted bytes:", g['datagrams'][0]['bytes'])

# datagram rows for empty wire & bad-header datagram
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(b''), datagram(bytes([0x40])), datagram(b'\x00')])
g = check("datagram-rows", tr, {'datagrams.0.packets':0, 'datagrams.0.accepted':0,
                                'datagrams.1.packets':1, 'datagrams.1.accepted':0,
                                'datagrams.2.packets':0, 'packets.1.status':'BAD_HEADER'})
print("   empty hash:", g['datagrams'][0]['sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest())

# crypto reassembly + overlap mismatch
c1 = crypto(0, b'abc')
c2 = crypto(1, b'X')
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, c1+c2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("crypto-overlap", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', 'crypto.0.ranges':[]})
c2 = crypto(1, b'b')
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, c1+c2, width=1), auth=[0])])
g = check("crypto-equal", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'crypto.0.ranges':[[0,3]], 'crypto.0.unique':3,
                               'crypto.0.prefix':3, 'crypto.0.sha256': hashlib.sha256(b'abc').hexdigest()})

# crypto across levels independent
tr = trace([dict(keys=['I','H','A']), datagram(envelope('I', 0, crypto(0,b'ab'), width=1), auth=[0]),
            datagram(envelope('H', 0, crypto(0,b'xy'), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("crypto-levels", tr, {'crypto.0.ranges':[[0,2]], 'crypto.1.ranges':[[0,2]]})

# stream ranges with holes and prefix
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'ab', fin=False)
f2 = stream(0, 4, b'cd', fin=False)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+f2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("stream-holes", tr, {'streams.0.ranges':[[0,2],[4,6]], 'streams.0.unique':4, 'streams.0.prefix':2, 'streams.0.high':6, 'used':6})

# MAX_DATA/STREAM_DATA monotone; rollback of monotone state on error
m1 = bytes([0x10]) + W.v(9)
m2 = bytes([0x10]) + W.v(4)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, m1+m2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("maxdata-monotone", tr, {'send_max_data':9})
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, m1+b'\x99', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("maxdata-rollback", tr, {'send_max_data':0})

# DUPLICATE doesn't alter state; discards don't decode frames
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, stream(0,0,b'ab'), width=1), auth=[0]),
            datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x99', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("dup-no-decode", tr, {'packets.1.status':'DUPLICATE', 'streams.0.ranges':[[0,2]], 'closed':None})
